consequence.statement: The etcd.managed Helm configuration value will no longer be honored in Cilium 1.16.0; environments using this setting must migrate to an alternative etcd deployment method.
consequence.remediation: Remove the etcd.managed configuration and any related etcd Helm values from your values.yaml. Deploy etcd independently or use an existing etcd cluster without relying on Cilium's managed etcd functionality.

original.statement: The Helm option for deploying a managed etcd instance via etcd.managed and other related Helm configurations have been removed.

consequence.statement: Setting etcd.managed or the related managed-etcd Helm values has no effect from 1.16.0: the option for deploying a managed etcd instance through the chart has been removed.
consequence.remediation: Remove etcd.managed and related managed-etcd values from your Helm values. If you relied on the chart-managed etcd instance, provide etcd by other means before upgrading.

corrected.statement: In Cilium 1.16.0 the Helm option etcd.managed and related Helm configurations were removed. Values that still set them are no longer honoured, and the chart no longer offers a managed etcd instance through them.

decision.reason: [ev-d6d613eadc25] says the Helm option for deploying a managed etcd instance via `etcd.managed`, and related Helm configurations, have been removed. A removed Helm key is no longer honoured, so setting-ignored fits. The proposed statement goes too far, though: it says environments "must migrate to an alternative etcd deployment method", and the evidence never states a required migration or what breaks beyond the option no longer working. I narrowed the statement and remediation to what the text supports and lowered severity, since the impact is not stated.
